notes.title: Attending Tokyo Game Show
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I will be going to TGS 2024 in a few days. Like Birds is not a game big enough to have a place in the show yet, but I hope I can get some insight and inspiration there.

If anyone else is attending too, I hope all of you enjoy the event also. If not, I hope you have a great day regardless.

Thank you.
